Name: The Stalker
Author: GyGyaru
Description:
[size=4][b]Something lives down there. And it's noticed you.[/b][/size]

Spend too long in the Mines or the Skull Cavern and you'll get a warning. After that, you're not alone anymore.

You can't fight it. You can only run.

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[/list]
[b]Install[/b]
Unzip into your [i]Mods[/i] folder and launch the game through SMAPI.

[b]Multiplayer[/b]
Works in multiplayer. Each player who has the mod gets their own Stalker, and only they can see it.

[b]⚠ Spoilers below![/b] If you'd rather find out for yourself, stop reading here.

[spoiler]
[list]
[*]The Stalker wakes up after about 4 in-game hours in a row underground.[/*]
[*]It can't be hurt and drifts through walls. The closer it gets, the louder your heartbeat and the redder your vision.[/*]
[*]Take a ladder down and, a few seconds later, it comes down after you.[/*]
[*]The longer it hunts, the faster it gets.[/*]
[*]Floors with an elevator (5, 10, 15... 120) are safe: it can't follow you there.[/*]
[*]In the Skull Cavern, nowhere is safe.[/*]
[*]If it catches you, you pass out, just like being knocked out in the mines.[/*]
[*]Leaving the mines or starting a new day makes it lose your trail.[/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

Manifest.Name: The Stalker
Manifest.Description: Stay underground too long and something starts hunting you. It follows you down the ladders, floor after floor, and if it catches you, you pass out. Only elevator floors are safe; in the Skull Cavern, nowhere is.
Manifest.Author: Becky
